targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM signal_events WHERE source = ANY(string_to_array('$source', ',')) AND ts_event BETWEEN extract(epoch from $__timeFrom())::bigint * 1000000000 AND extract(epoch from $__timeTo())::bigint * 1000000000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT source)::bigint AS value FROM signal_events WHERE source = ANY(string_to_array('$source', ',')) AND ts_event BETWEEN extract(epoch from $__timeFrom())::bigint * 1000000000 AND extract(epoch from $__timeTo())::bigint * 1000000000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_version)::bigint AS value FROM signal_events WHERE source = ANY(string_to_array('$source', ',')) AND ts_event BETWEEN extract(epoch from $__timeFrom())::bigint * 1000000000 AND extract(epoch from $__timeTo())::bigint * 1000000000

SELECT AVG(confidence)::float AS value FROM signal_events WHERE source = ANY(string_to_array('$source', ',')) AND ts_event BETWEEN extract(epoch from $__timeFrom())::bigint * 1000000000 AND extract(epoch from $__timeTo())::bigint * 1000000000

SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE side='buy'))::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE side='sell'), 0) AS value FROM signal_events WHERE source = ANY(string_to_array('$source', ',')) AND ts_event BETWEEN extract(epoch from $__timeFrom())::bigint * 1000000000 AND extract(epoch from $__timeTo())::bigint * 1000000000
SELECT extract(epoch from now()) - MAX(ts_event)/1e9 AS value FROM signal_events WHERE source = ANY(string_to_array('$source', ','))

SELECT time_bucket($__interval::interval, to_timestamp(ts_event/1e9)) AS time, source, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM signal_events WHERE source = ANY(string_to_array('$source', ',')) AND ts_event BETWEEN extract(epoch from $__timeFrom())::bigint * 1000000000 AND extract(epoch from $__timeTo())::bigint * 1000000000 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket($__interval::interval, to_timestamp(ts_event/1e9)) AS time, side, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM signal_events WHERE source = ANY(string_to_array('$source', ',')) AND ts_event BETWEEN extract(epoch from $__timeFrom())::bigint * 1000000000 AND extract(epoch from $__timeTo())::bigint * 1000000000 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket($__interval::interval, to_timestamp(ts_event/1e9)) AS time, percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY confidence) AS p25, percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY confidence) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY confidence) AS p75, percentile_cont(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY confidence) AS p90 FROM signal_events WHERE source = ANY(string_to_array('$source', ',')) AND ts_event BETWEEN extract(epoch from $__timeFrom())::bigint * 1000000000 AND extract(epoch from $__timeTo())::bigint * 1000000000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket($__interval::interval, to_timestamp(ts_event/1e9)) AS time, MIN(score) AS min, AVG(score) AS mean, MAX(score) AS max FROM signal_events WHERE source = ANY(string_to_array('$source', ',')) AND ts_event BETWEEN extract(epoch from $__timeFrom())::bigint * 1000000000 AND extract(epoch from $__timeTo())::bigint * 1000000000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT source, model_version, COUNT(*)::bigint AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE side='buy')::bigint AS buy, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE side='sell')::bigint AS sell, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE side='flat')::bigint AS flat, ROUND(AVG(confidence)::numeric, 4) AS mean_conf, ROUND(AVG(score)::numeric, 6) AS mean_score, to_timestamp(MIN(ts_event)/1e9) AS first_ts, to_timestamp(MAX(ts_event)/1e9) AS last_ts FROM signal_events WHERE source = ANY(string_to_array('$source', ',')) AND ts_event BETWEEN extract(epoch from $__timeFrom())::bigint * 1000000000 AND extract(epoch from $__timeTo())::bigint * 1000000000 GROUP BY source, model_version ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT to_timestamp(ts_event/1e9) AS ts, source, model_version, symbol, side, ROUND(score::numeric, 4) AS score, ROUND(confidence::numeric, 4) AS confidence, horizon, status FROM signal_events WHERE source = ANY(string_to_array('$source', ',')) AND ts_event BETWEEN extract(epoch from $__timeFrom())::bigint * 1000000000 AND extract(epoch from $__timeTo())::bigint * 1000000000 ORDER BY ts_event DESC LIMIT 100
